text: Ships as a managed, read-only bundle that stays in sync with vendor updates instead of a fork you own outright
quote: installs the whole set as a managed, read-only bundle that updates when I ship, so you subscribe rather than fork

text: Explicit `npx skills update` command controls exactly when vendor changes reach your project — nothing updates silently
quote: Nothing updates behind your back; pull my latest changes when you want them with `npx skills update`.

text: Setup wizard asks which issue tracker to use — GitHub, Linear, or local files
quote: Ask you which issue tracker you want to use (GitHub, Linear, or local files)

text: Installer copies skill files into your project as editable, ordinary files you can customize
quote: copies editable skill files into your project, so you can hack on them and make them your own

text: Alignment skills get the agent to think deeply and align with you before every code change
quote: They help you align with the agent before you get started, and think deeply about the change you're making. Use them _every_ time you want to make a change.

text: A 'grilling' session interviews you and the agent together, building shared vocabulary and documenting hard decisions as ADRs
quote: This is built into [`/grill-with-docs`]... It's a grilling session, but that helps you build a shared language with the AI, and document hard-to-explain decisions in ADR's.

text: Enforces a red-green-refactor loop where the agent writes a failing test first, then makes it pass
quote: a red-green-refactor loop is critical. This is where the agent writes a failing test first, then fixes the test.

text: Requires tests to be written only at seams pre-agreed with the user before any test is coded
quote: Test only at pre-agreed seams. Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user.

text: Interviews the user relentlessly to build a shared 'design tree' of understanding before work starts
quote: Interview the user relentlessly until you reach a shared understanding. Map this as a **design tree**

text: Moves issues and PRs through a defined triage state machine — categorise, verify, grill if needed, write agent-ready briefs
quote: Move issues on the project issue tracker through a small state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

text: Before grilling/triaging a claim, verifies it holds up — e.g. reproduces a bug from the reporter's steps
quote: Verify the claim. Before any grilling, check that the claim holds up. For a bug, reproduce it from the reporter's steps.

text: One-time setup skill scaffolds per-repo config (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs) that the other skills assume
quote: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

text: Accepted into Claude Code's official plugin marketplace with a documented `claude plugins install` command
quote: `mattpocock-skills` was accepted into **Claude Code's official marketplace**... `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` is now the documented route

text: Turns an agreed conversation into a written spec document
quote: Turn an agreed conversation into a written spec.

text: Splits a spec into small tickets sized for an agent to build
quote: Split a spec into small tickets an agent can build.

text: Builds a finished spec into working code test-first
quote: Build a finished spec into code, test-first.

text: Reviews a code diff against both team standards and the original spec
quote: Review a diff against your standards and against the spec.

text: Charts a large effort as a map of decisions and helps settle them
quote: Chart a large effort as a map of decisions, and settle them.

text: Answers a design question by writing throwaway exploratory code that is deleted afterward
quote: Answer a design question with code you then delete.

text: Produces a cited answer sourced from primary documentation
quote: Get a cited answer, read from primary sources.

text: Generates a visual report identifying which modules are worth refactoring
quote: Find the modules worth refactoring, as a visual report.

text: Diagnoses a hard bug starting from a failing reproduction case
quote: Diagnose a hard bug, starting from a repro that fails.

text: Walks through finishing a merge or rebase conflict hunk by hunk
quote: Finish a merge or rebase conflict, hunk by hunk.

text: Generates a script that walks a human through environment setup
quote: Generate a script that walks a human through setup.

text: Writes up a long working session so a different agent can pick up where it left off
quote: Write up a long session so another agent can continue it.

text: Includes a meta-skill that figures out which other skill applies to your current situation
quote: Find out which skill to use for the situation you are in.

text: Ships a CONTEXT.md-style document that helps agents decode project-specific jargon
quote: It's a document that helps agents decode the jargon used in the project.

text: Encourages vertical-slice development: one test then one implementation, repeated as tracer bullets
quote: Work in vertical slices instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a tracer bullet

text: Positioned as not owning your whole process (unlike GSD/BMAD/Spec-Kit), leaving you in control
quote: Approaches like GSD, BMAD, and Spec-Kit try to help by owning the process. But while doing so, they take away your control

text: Sorts raw incoming issues into well-defined, pickable units of work
quote: Sort raw issues into work someone can pick up.

text: Grills the user relentlessly to stress-test a plan, decision, or idea and records the resulting decisions
quote: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking

text: Tests are required to verify behavior through public interfaces, not internal implementation details
quote: Tests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details.

text: Treats a PR as an issue with attached code, running it through the same roles/states/machine as issue triage
quote: a PR is an issue with attached code, using the same roles, same states, and same machine

text: Skill collection works across multiple agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot — with 25 skills under MIT license
quote: Works with any agent Claude Code · Cursor · Codex · Copilot · 25 skills · MIT

text: Lets you install only the specific skills you want, then invoke them via a slash command
quote: Install the ones you want, then type a slash command.

text: Installer lets you pick which skills and which agents to target, writing editable files into your project
quote: Pick the skills and agents you use. The installer writes editable files into your project.
